meaning.en: Year, in two-digit, numeric format, as in: dd/mm/yy.
meaning.vi: Năm, ở định dạng số, hai chữ số, như trong: dd / mm / yy.

sentences.en: Without attempting to answer this question categorically, it may be pointed out that within the limits of the family (Ptychoderidae) which is especially characterized by their presence there are some species in Y art dY YY cts, posterior limit of collar.

sentences.en: It's a YY MM format (for example, 06.12 is December 2006).
